semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in wafer transfer equipment and automated material handling systems critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Shanghai GoNa Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd is a leading provider of wafer transfer equipment and automated material handling systems, including EFEMs, sorters, and stockers. The company focuses on R&D and production, catering to both domestic and international markets with a commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

regional_presence.China: The company has established a high-standard intelligent semiconductor equipment production base in Haining and has branch offices in Wuhan and Beijing for on-site services.
